t: How much remembrance is asked for
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanu-dhkuru-llāha dhikran kathīrā, wa sabbiḥūhu bukratan wa aṣīlā.
m: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
